summary: True two-client authority evidence currently omits the two canonical schema-version fields that the source-owned full Physics Lab snapshot treats as truth. Public PhysicsLabValidation requires UNRENDERED_LabSchemaVersion and UNRENDERED_ResolvedRegionSchemaVersion, but the private bridge driver_two_client canonicalIdentity/client identity payload omits both, and evaluate_evidence.py defines an exact identity key set that also omits them. Therefore a future two-client PASS can prove recipe/world/region/seed/fingerprint/repro/count agreement while never proving lab-schema or resolved-region-schema agreement. Adding the fields only in the public authority backfill would currently be rejected as unexpected by the bridge evaluator. Recommend a bounded bridge + public-contract follow-up: version the two-client identity schema, transport both positive-integer schema versions from server and each independent client, require exact parity in evaluator tests, preserve fail-closed unknown-field semantics, then have the public HG-BACKFILL-AUTHORITY lane consume that contract without inventing Instance authority. Do not retry Studio while OPS-STUDIO-DISPLAY remains red.
